The Punchcard Artifact is an EPIC Accessory.

  • 2 Usage
    • 2.1 Game Message

Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

The Punchcard Artifact can be bid on at  Barrier Street. The top 25 bidders win the item.

Usage

[edit | edit source]
Accessory
Punchcard Artifact
  •  Rift Time: +30
Effects

Ability: Punch in! LEFT CLICK
Punch another player while this is in your inventory to both regain +25  Rift Time.
Usable once per player per rift visit up to 20 players.

The Punchcard Artifact allows the player to punch other players to regain +25  Rift Time.

Game Message

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Punched someone
PUNCHCARD! You punched <player> and both regained +25ф Rift Time!
Punched by someone
PUNCHED! You were punched by <player> and both regained +25ф Rift Time!
Punched 20 players in a session
UH OH! You reached the limit of 20 players you can punch in one session!
Punched the same player after rejoining a session
AWKWARD! This player has already been punched by you... somehow!

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Punching is a feature in Hypixel Lobbies, allowing players to hit staff members, making them fly in the air.
  • It has the same texture as the 9F Operator Chip.
  • While you can only punch 20 players per rift visit, there is seemingly no limit to how many players can punch you.
    • In theory, this would allow for infinite  Rift Time.

History

[edit | edit source]
